source: Owner direct chat after selecting Utility AI and GOAP
owner_messages_original: Предположим я выбираю Utility AI и GOAP. Какой бы у нас был план на текущей стадии? существуюшее перепишем тогда?
Тогда давай подробный план и задачи новые, будем перестриаваить и строить новую систему в соответствии с Utility AI + GOAP
все что нужно снести касательно ИИ и сделать заного, лучше снести сразу кстати, оставляем только действительно хорошее.
owner_messages_english_translation: Suppose I choose Utility AI and GOAP. What would our plan be at the current stage? Would we rewrite the existing system then?
Then give me a detailed plan and new tasks; we will restructure and build a new system based on Utility AI + GOAP.
Everything concerning AI that needs to be removed and made again is better removed immediately, by the way; keep only the genuinely good parts.
decision: Select Utility AI for goal arbitration and GOAP for action planning. Prepare a detailed replacement design, implementation sequence and new Multica tasks. Remove obsolete active AI early in implementation; retain only individually justified primitives.
interpretation: The latest message steers the requested plan and task preparation toward clean replacement. The first implementation package removes the old autonomous policy, ownership and local navigation, with an explicitly passive/manual intermediate. The next package restores a minimal autonomous enemy using the new brain. No selectable legacy fallback or dual autonomous controllers.
administrative_scope: Create a coordination parent under MSQ-67 and bounded backlog children. Supersede the thirteen verified unassigned zero-run MSQ-105 through MSQ-117 tasks with explicit successor links and cancelled status. Retain MSQ-101 as a historical coordination index with its delivered children and a supersession notice. Preserve external mechanics tasks, except the minimal MSQ-72 dependency and dispatch note required to use new individual cover before its one-enemy lifecycle fixture; its original acceptance and cap of three remain, with group enablement in UG-04.
execution_boundary: This package delivers the requested plan and new tasks. It does not dispatch production or perform the planned source removal. Use administrative services, --no-start for issue updates and unassigned backlog creation. Future execution uses the standing project workflow.
supersedes: Earlier proposals to keep an active legacy selector/local-navigation fallback, wrap complete cover/mobile controllers, or defer the choice of GOAP. Earlier architecture and future-task ordering remain historical; their gameplay intent and applicable evidence survive through the explicit replacement mapping.
preservation: Preserve owner edits, assets, sources, Git history, delivered task status, historical reviews and exact candidate evidence. Clean replacement is not permission to delete assets or evidence. Keep canonical GASPALS/CMC, finite projectiles, actual weapon safety and physical authority through verified extracted interfaces.
review: One primary independent technical planning review, max reasoning and standard speed. This decision grants no inherited review waiver and no new gameplay-testing exception.
